draftContext.markdown:
Fourteen findings from PR #602 are recorded and merged but unsettled — no finding has been accepted, revised, or dispositioned by the independent action review. The original Nov 22 article remains live with known errors. No gate is currently formally blocked on finding disposition, but C1 (FleetRunner pipeline completeness) and C13 (DailyLogger service attribution) affect how any reader assesses what has actually shipped and is running. Whether any finding requires a correction merge to the Nov 22 article is a disposition question for the independent action review.

Core #724 (six test files never run in CI) opened during this interval and is not gated by any formal blocker. This is an integrity gap in the CI layer that the trust-build enforcement mechanism depends on. No urgency has been assigned in the supplied evidence.

Core #725 (fleet rule proposal: model-written claims must name source, quote it, and mark unquoted claims as hypotheses) and github-actions #4 (shared security scan dependency audit can never fail) also opened during the interval sweep. Neither is formally gated.

The 114 trust-build slices (core #694–#720, daily-logger #596–#601) are all open at gate-0. The enforcement mechanism (core #723) is in place. No slice has started. No projected start date or forcing function is recorded. RETRO-0 cannot close until all PH8 slices carry closed-with-proof evidence; the check command is `node scripts/check-trust-phase-proof.mjs --phase PH8`.

The daily-logger draft queue (#566–#584) has an explicit prerequisite chain: shared-journal refactor slices (#576–#583) must precede service-runtime work (#573–#575, #584). The specific blocker for #576 (first in chain) is not named in the supplied context. The sixteen drafts have not moved during this interval.

[HouseholdAgentKit] #1 remains in review with no named reviewer, no merge condition, and no owner gate recorded. Its dependency status is unknown from supplied evidence.

Core #636 (replace stale Frame-wide context) is open in draft; whether it gates accurate orientation for trust-build slice pickup is not established by supplied evidence but is a reasonable question for the owner to answer before PH8 work begins.

How many times the DailyLogger service/Actions writer conflation has appeared in the article record prior to C13 is not established. Quantifying that recurrence rate would let the audit layer assess whether the finding frequency is declining.
